title: One proxy trap

blocks.md:
## Trap `get`, do not build a framework

`new Proxy(target, { get(t, key) { return Reflect.get(t, key) } })` intercepts reads. A `get` trap runs when you read a field, not when you write one.

Use it once to default missing dirs to `"east"`.

The desk wraps a blank route card. Asking for `unknown` still returns `"east"`, so the fox has a fallback heading.

blocks.promptMd: A `get` trap runs when you {{a}} a field.
blocks.explainMd: get is the read trap. set would run on a write. deleteProperty would run on delete.

blocks.promptMd: > Proxy a `{}` so missing keys return `"east"`. Print `wrap.unknown`.

hintLadder.md: In `get`, return the real field when it exists, otherwise `"east"`.
get(t, key) { return key in t ? t[key] : "east" }

description: Intercept one read or write and decide what it means.
